# s209 — Require a current-attempt note before handing off

An implementer must leave the configured report for this attempt before handing work to a reviewer. A report left before rejection cannot authorize a later attempt's handoff.

**Findings:** agents feedback 2026-10-05 U3b; docs/feedback/agents-2026-10-05.md · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** requiring human verification, filtering reports by expiry, changing done, or accepting a history-only handoff note as a report.

## Why

U3 reports a handoff with no implementer report. The owner selected current-attempt enforcement rather than accepting any historical report. Structured notes carry their attempt; the attempt-count correction is a prerequisite.

## Files

Config validation, handoff operations, config/command/agent documentation, note/handoff/render-gate tests, and CHANGELOG.md.

## Failing tests

- Missing/empty requirement retains current handoff behavior. A nonempty required kind absent from a configured whitelist is a config error.
- Handoff without a nonempty matching current-attempt note fails with code state and names item/kind; index, slices, history and render stay unchanged, including strict rendering.
- A current-attempt report allows handoff. A wrong kind, legacy unknown-attempt note, or previous-attempt report does not.
- Reject then restart requires a new report; release and resume of the same attempt do not invalidate its report.
- Batch handoff with one missing report refuses the whole batch. A no-op handoff of an already unclaimed review item remains a no-op.

## Implement

Add optional handoff_requires_note_kind, a string empty by default. Cross-validate it against a nonempty note_kinds whitelist. Protect the saved config policy with the appropriate newer config schema while loading older files with no requirement.

Before changing any started item's status or claim, require an item note whose kind matches, whose text is nonempty, and whose attempt equals the current count. Collect missing-report errors with existing handoff validation before any batch write. Historical notes with null attempt cannot satisfy the rule. Apply the check to actual started-to-review transitions; already-in-review unclaimed no-ops need no new report.

Record the required kind and how to file the current-attempt report in agent guidance. Do not infer a report from fixed prefixes, history text, authorship, or selected read filters. Attempts remain an owner-editable counter; document that changing it manually changes report association.

Run focused current-attempt, batch atomicity and strict-render rollback tests, then full unittest discovery, tracking check, and git diff --check.
